register.labelZh: LET 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: let somebody off 可以表示免除處罰或責任;let somebody through 則可以表示讓人或車輛通過。；let somebody down 可以表示令人失望;let something down 則可表示一個弱點拖累整體表現。；你可以用 school lets out 表示放學、用 let out a scream 表示尖叫,也可以用 let rain in 表示讓雨水進入。；單獨使用 let off 是表示放屁的英式非正式用法;school 或 work lets out 則是常見的美式說法。
register.summaryEn: Let somebody off can remove a punishment or duty, while let somebody through allows a person or vehicle to pass. Let somebody down shows disappointment. Let something down shows that one weak point makes the whole result less successful. You can say that school lets out, somebody lets out a scream, or a hole lets rain in. Bare let off is informal British English for passing wind. School or work lets out is common American English.
